Boko

Convert ebooks in your browser. EPUB → Kindle KFX and back, plus AZW3 / MOBI → EPUB. Nothing is uploaded.

About & limitations

What this does: Runs boko-kai — the converter behind sidle — compiled to WebAssembly. .epub becomes a Kindle .kfx; .kfx, .azw3, and .mobi become .epub.

Privacy: 100% client-side. The book is read into memory, converted by the in-page WebAssembly module, and handed back as a download. It never leaves your device — there is no server.

KFX still needs your Kindle: this makes the .kfx file; getting it onto the device (USB, or the Sidle KUAL app) is a separate step.

Performance: text-heavy books and all EPUB → KFX conversions are fast. Image-heavy KFX → EPUB is slower — JPEG-XR images are decoded single-threaded in the browser, and a large book may freeze the page for a few seconds while it works.

DRM: DRM-protected files (Adobe ADEPT, Apple FairPlay, Amazon DRM) cannot be read.

All data stays on your device.
Updated at 2026/05/25 · built with Rust + WebAssembly (boko-kai)
